agent.summary:
All three reported alerts have cleared. Storefront checks return HTTP 200, frontend error rates are zero, and accounting has no Kafka backlog.

Frontend failures came from ad-service connection refusals during startup. Accounting’s alert incorrectly counted Kafka idle waiting as processing latency; I corrected that rule. I also restored Jaeger and repaired its configuration to unblock telemetry export. Jaeger still reports a storage compatibility warning.
